q: Barbalat's lemma: if a uniformly continuous function f: [0,∞) → ℝ satisfies ∫₀^∞ f(t) dt < ∞, then:
exp: Barbalat's lemma: uniform continuity + square integrability (or absolute integrability) → f(t) → 0. This is used in adaptive control and Lyapunov stability analysis when V̇ ≤ 0 only (not strict): Barbalat gives convergence of V̇ to 0 even when V̇ < 0 fails, via the integrated bound on V̇.
